ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High ratio of low-intensity pixels (black/dark grey) to high-intensity pixels (white); approximately 90% of the visible surface area is comprised of low-intensity pixel values.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large-scale contiguous dark-intensity region covering the central and proximal areas of both lobes; high-contrast white pixel clusters are localized specifically at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; interior angle of approximately 50 degrees with a clear vertex dividing the two lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular jagged boundary with high-frequency serrations; peak amplitude is highest on the distal third of the left lobe trailing edge, showing sharp vertical variations against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward sweep originating from the median notch, terminating in tapered, slightly recurved distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-intensity white pixels located at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes; smaller, isolated circular white pixel clusters visible on the lower right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, near-horizontal light-grey linear streaks (rake marks) detected on the mid-section of the right lobe, oriented perpendicular to the fluke's vertical axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct irregular notch or 'nick' is visible on the inner trailing edge of the left lobe, approximately 25% of the distance from the median notch to the tip; significant white pigment scarring on the distal extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, isolated high-intensity circular spot is located in the bottom-center region of the right lobe surface.
